the EPR concept with the green manufacturing and CSR concept can reduce waste of fish processing industries.

there is a significant relationship between green manufacturing with the collection of recyclable waste products of fish cans, CSR significantly affects collection of waste products of fish canned, the collection of recyclability of waste products of canned fish significantly affect the recyclability of waste, and the cost of recyclable waste significantly affect the processing of recyclable waste.

the effect relationship between green manufacturing, CSR and EPR in order to reduce environmental pollutions caused by canned fish waste.
the effect of the green manufacturing and CSR to collection of recyclables in the fish canning industry.
the implementation of Extended Producer Responsibility in the fish canning industry.

green manufacturing, CSR and collection of recyclables are significantly affecting the recyclables processing and cost EPR.

the implementation of green manufacturing and CSR can be an effective alternative to EPR in order to reduce the waste of canned fish industry.

the concept of green manufacture and CSR is a solution to reduce the amount of waste products of the fish canning industry and the cost of EPR.
